title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18

By planting over 500,000 trees, Roosevelt transformed the surrounding landscape. This pivotal donation secured the lasting preservation of this notable presidential site, which became both America’s first presidential library and a cherished national historic landmark.

title: Aryan Nishad’s Bribes FYI shuts down after going viral, seeks help to return
content: Bribes.fyi, the crowdsourced anti-bribery platform created by Aryan Nishad, has been temporarily shut down after going unexpectedly viral, recording more than 5 million requests and around 200,000 new users in 48 hours, according to a LinkedIn update. The team says it plans to return after putting stronger legal and financial infrastructure in place. The development has also prompted calls for lawyers and Chartered Accountants to help address concerns around verification, misuse, privacy, legal risks and platform governance.

title: Manav Suthar creates history: Youngest Indian to take 10-wicket haul in away Test

This win earned India crucial World Test Championship points.

The accused posed as a doctor to convince associates of the false plan.

However, Strickland later expressed sympathy and defended Poirier's sponsorship situation.

title: Crude oil shock may squeeze affordable housing but premium homes stay resilient

The luxury housing segment is expected to stay stable despite affordability hurdles, while both office leasing and industrial warehousing are anticipated to flourish. title: Russia turns to Asia for refined fuel, set to receive nearly 270,000 tonnes in Aug

Russia has also tightened its own fuel export curbs to manage shortages.

content: the pakitan supreme court ordered the transfer of jailed former prime minister to a private hospital within two days . the move could end hopes of imran Khan’s family and Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) who have repeatedly sought better treatment .

title: Iran claims control, ships choose Omani route: What's changing in Strait of Hormuz

title: Trump-Bibi tensions deepen? US officials frustrated by Israel’s Syria strikes: Report
content: at least eight Israeli bombs struck the runways and several hangars at the airbase early Tuesday . the strikes came as the Trump administration has sought to strengthen ties with Syria's government under president Ahmed al-Sharaa . president obama said the operation was intended to deter Turkey from sending sophisticated weapons systems to the facility .

title: Bihar: Water cannon used as RJD leaders march to Raj Bhavan; Tejashwi, Misa detained
content: AK-47 rifles were used against students protesting over paper leak issue . a foot march was held in patna towards Raj Bhavan . the march raises concerns over papers leaks, unemployment and issues affecting students and youth .

title: 'Because Punjab election is coming up': Satyendar Jain cries foul after arrest
content: alleged irregularities in the Delhi Jal Board's (DJB) tendering process . the arrest of the loyalist came a day earlier in connection with alleged DJB scam . former chief minister and aAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal has also questioned the arrest .

title: Spanish woman trains 18 rescued donkeys to help prevent wildfires
content: the “firefighting donkeys” of Doana National Park have been grazing for up to seven hours a day, clearing dry vegetation and creating natural firebreaks that help prevent wildfires before they start . since 2014, they have been turning conservation heroes by a spanish woman with a bold idea .

title: 'I stand with them': Rahul backs protest by tribals against 'Ken-Betwa project'
content: tribal residents have been holding a Satyagraha against the Ken-Betwa River Link project . they want adequate compensation and dignified rehabilitation for people whose land is being acquired . the government has promised to visit the protest site to pressure the government .

title: Vijay govt revokes order barring students from Left, CJP protests in Tamil Nadu
content: TN govt rolls back order to prevent students, youth from joining political protests and agitations . the directive had asked education departments, police and district administrations to coordinate efforts to discourage participation . it specifically referred to protest and protest programmes organised by Left-wing parties and the Cockroach Janata Party .

title: 'There's a problem at the border': Rijiju admits delineation confusion in Arunachal
content: union minister says there is a problem at the border but only because the boundary has not been delineated . concerns raised by villagers in the frontier state are valid, but warned against spreading misinformation about Chinese troops entering Indian territory .
